note: Triangularity and the marked error are the `Triangle` hypothesis of the Lean step lemmas, and the physical quotient with corrected inclusions appears as `X.rise` in `limit_lower`. The citations of Lemmas E2.2 and F2 are not separate statements.

snippet.text:
structure Triangle (m : ℕ) (x y : F.Coeff → F.Coeff) : Prop where
  leads : ∃ T : Heading F, (∃ c : ℝ, Push.Local.Leading T.map.toLinearMap c) ∧
    (∀ v, F.coeffSize (T.map v) ≤ W.K (H.levels.clock.J (m+1))*F.coeffSize v ∧
          F.coeffSize (T.map.symm v) ≤ W.K (H.levels.clock.J (m+1))*F.coeffSize v) ∧
    ∀ v, F.coeffSize (y v - T.leads (H.S.block m) (x v)) ≤
      barunit (H.S.block m) * F.coeffSize (F.core (x v))

proof_context.conclusion: `Triangle` bundles a `Leading` (triangular, diagonal) map `T.map`, its two-sided `K`-bound, and the marked error `barunit * coeffSize (core (x v))`.

lemma limit_lower (v : Rowe C d) (x : C.label d) {b : Filter Cutoffs} [b.NeBot]
    (he : e < d) (hp : b ≤ f.fuse)
    (hw : ∀ᶠ i in b, low F e (((K!) i).symm (v i))=((K!) i).symm (v i))
    (hx : Tendsto v b (𝓝 x)) : S.project d x ∈ LinearMap.range (X.rise he.le) := by

proof_context.conclusion: A limit of vectors lying in the transported low plane has `S.project d x` in the range of `X.rise`, the corrected inclusion into the lower field.
